chapter_seo_title: Ji Ning Reunites With the Skygreen Serpent – A Fiery Rescue in the Wilderness
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning finds his old rival the Skygreen Serpent besieged by Wanxiang demons. A one-shot kill and a warm reunion lead to a cold ultimatum for the Dragon Whale King.
og_description: Ji Ning rescues his old sparring partner from a sixteen-demon ambush. Old friends meet again – with swords.
twitter_description: Ji Ning reunites with the Skygreen Serpent and immediately threatens to kill a Wanxiang perfection demon king. What a way to say hello.
